outcome_evidence: The robot approaches the upper drawer and aligns with its handle in frames 31–79 in left_ego_image and wrist_image, then closes its gripper around the handle in frames 80–95. Frames 100–119 in image and left_ego_image show the drawer moving outward, exposing its side and the opening above it. The robot releases and withdraws in frames 127–164, leaving the drawer visibly open in left_ego_image. No failed acquisition, harmful collision, or displacement of unrelated tabletop objects is visible.
